form.narrative: Collided with a divider after swerving to avoid a pedestrian. The car was being driven by the insured's cousin, whose learner permit had expired a year earlier.

photo.description: Minor scratches and scuffs on the rear bumper.
photo.summary: This image shows the rear of a white vehicle with visible damage on the bumper. The license plate on the left side of the vehicle reads "ZF". There is a logo on the top left side of the bumper with the text "6x6" inside it. The ground appears to be a paved surface with some shadows cast on it. The vehicle's shadow is visible on the ground, indicating the position of the sun.
